observations: Two red boxes labeled 'Wireless Controller' are placed on top of a white console.
The boxes feature images of a white controller with a central analog stick and multiple buttons.
A black power cable with a UK-style 3-pin plug is visible.
A black HDMI cable is coiled in front of the boxes.
The console itself is white, with a visible power button and a small logo on the front edge.
The console appears to be a standard PS4 Pro model, but the brand is not visible on the console itself.
The seller's text claims it is a 'PlayStation 4 Pro', but the console's branding is not readable in the photo.

claims.claim: Get the ultimate gaming experience with this PlayStation 4 Pro.
claims.evidence: The console is visible, but its brand and model are not readable. The seller's claim cannot be confirmed from the photo.
Performance claims cannot be verified from photos alone.

risks.risk: The console may be a counterfeit or non-genuine unit.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the console's front bezel or back panel showing the official PlayStation logo and model number.
risks.if_unproven: priced as a generic or non-genuine console, which is significantly cheaper than a genuine PS4 Pro.

risks.risk: The console may be damaged or non-functional.
risks.proof: A video showing the console powering on, booting up, and displaying the PS4 Pro home screen.
risks.if_unproven: priced as not working, which reduces value to scrap or parts.

risks.risk: The controller may be missing or damaged.
risks.proof: A photo of the controller itself, showing all buttons and joysticks, and a video of it connecting to the console.
risks.if_unproven: priced as missing or non-functional, which reduces value.

proof_requests: A clear photo of the console's front bezel or back panel showing the official PlayStation logo and model number.
A video showing the console powering on and booting up.
A photo of the controller itself, showing all buttons and joysticks.
A photo of the console's power and HDMI ports to confirm they are present and undamaged.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
